label: Hunting Horn
metaLabel: Honed Blade + Razor + Weakness Exploit + Maestro
note: MH3U endgame HH play centers on Nether Sinphony (1196 display / 260 true raw, +5% affinity, 320 thunder, natural white, 30 purple with Sharpness +1) and the Honed Blade set: Sharpness +1 + Attack Up L, Razor Sharp, Weakness Exploit, and Horn Maestro, with Earplugs/Rock Steady or Evasion as flex. The model captures Sharpness +1 ('best'), Attack Up L (+20 true raw), and Nether's encored Attack & Defense Boost (S) song (1.15x); Razor Sharp, Weakness Exploit, Horn Maestro, Earplugs/Rock Steady, Evasion, the thunder element, and other songs are unmodeled. Sandsoother is the higher-raw Attack Boost (L) alternative (1.2x song) but has -25% affinity and hidden ice, so Nether remains the general-purpose pick.
